Subject: SLA & premium support questions / SOW attached

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited about Redwood as the serving layer for our analytics platform. I'm attaching a draft SOW (Nimbus_SOW_v1.pdf) and wanted to confirm a few things on support/SLA before we move to procurement: 

- Can you share published uptime tiers you price for (99.90 / 99.95 / 99.99)? What are typical delta pricing bands for support and for reserved capacity?
- Response times: we need clarity on business-hours vs 24x7 response SLAs and what constitutes an "incident" eligible for credits.
- Escalation coverage: for our compliance team, we need on-call escalation to include an engineering lead within 2 hours for severity-1 incidents — is that available as an add-on?
- Credits: how are uptime credits calculated (daily vs monthly), and what caps apply?
- Any pilot/intro pricing for the first 3 months while we validate traffic patterns?

Claire and I are prepping an internal procurement packet; if you can provide a simple menu we can include, that will speed review.

Regards,
Sam Patel
Head of Infrastructure, Nimbus Analytics
attachments: Nimbus_SOW_v1.pdf

Subject: Re: SLA & premium support questions / SOW attached

Sam — thanks for the SOW and great questions. Below is a compact menu to help procurement; I also attached an escalation map diagram (Escalation_Map_v3.png) that shows on-call ownership and routing. Happy to jump on a 20-min call if you want to walk through.

High-level pricing menu (guidance only; final pricing tied to reserved capacity and term):
- Base: 99.95% uptime SLA, business-hours triage (8x5), target initial response = 4 hours. Typical support fee: $5k/mo.
- Premium: 99.99% SLA, 24x7 triage with guaranteed response = 1 hour, includes an on-call engineering lead escalation path. Typical incremental: +$12k/mo above base.
- Core 99.90 option: $3k/mo, business-hours only, standard credit policy.

Credits & calculation: credits are monthly, pro-rated by minutes of SLA breach against monthly uptime target; caps: base plan capped at 10% of monthly support fee, premium cap at 20% for enterprise customers.

Escalation add-on: we can guarantee engineering lead engagement within 2 hours as a named add-on for customers on base or premium — pricing typically $6k/mo or a one-time ramp fee for guaranteed 24x7 coverage.

Pilot concession: we can offer a 3-month pilot discount: 20% off support fees and a waived onboarding fee if you commit to an annual reserved capacity by pilot start. Pilot still counts toward usage thresholds for discounts.

Next steps: if the above aligns, I'll loop in Marissa (commercial) to formalize the offer and draft a DocuSign-ready SOW.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

Evy — forwarding my quick notes on margin and discount levers for Nimbus (internal only).

On pricing bands: the $5k/$12k guidance is fine as a headline. If they want the 2-hour named-engagement add-on, we should target 50% margin post infra commit; that suggests sticker $6k/mo as you noted, with room for a 10-15% promotional discount.

Suggested commercial approach:
- Offer pilot concession (20% off support) only if they sign annual reserved capacity minimum (3 GPUs equivalent) and prepay first 3 months.
- For renewal/expansion: scale down % discount as usage grows — e.g., 20% first year, 10% second year, then reset standard pricing.
- Include a one-time onboarding surcharge (waived in pilot) to cover SOC evidence and HIPAA checklist work; add HIPAA_addendum.docx to the SOW.

I will prepare two pricing lines (Conservative and Accelerated) for DocuSign so procurement can pick faster.

—Marissa

Sam / Claire — quick summary and proposed path so procurement has a single playbook to review: 

1) Agreed commercial path (pilot -> annual):
   - Pilot: 3 months, 20% off support fees (applies to Base or Premium), onboarding fee waived if you commit to annual reserved capacity at pilot start.
   - Annual: 12-month term on reserved capacity; base support (99.95 / 4-hr business response) at $5k/mo baseline. Premium upgrade to 99.99 + 1-hr response + named engineering lead available at +$12k/mo.
2) Escalation add-on: 2-hour named engineering lead guaranteed (for compliance) available as an add-on at $6k/mo. We can discount that by 10-15% for the pilot bundle.
3) Credits: monthly pro-rated formula; cap at 10% (base) / 20% (premium). We'll include the exact formula and examples in the SOW.
4) Next doc steps: Marissa will issue two DocuSign templates (Conservative/Accelerated). I attached the updated SOW and HIPAA addendum and included a DocuSign link for convenience.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/XYZ-8721
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8721
